The initial term is three (3) years, with two (2) successive one (1) year renewal options, not to exceed a total of five (5) years. 2024-07-09T14:00:00 CST. Submissions may be submitted electronically via the iSupplier portal or manually by paper via mail/FedEx/UPS. The required deployment services include software installation (specifically autopilot for Windows devices and enrollment in Google Management for Chromebooks), asset tagging, asset decaling, etching, asset control reporting, and delivery to varied locations including new schools and new additions. Delivery schedules are to be coordinated with the Dallas ISD ED TECH department.
